data.name: Benildis
data.gender_notes: Benildis is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Latin, Benildis is derived from the elements benevolent (kind, generous) and dispenser (to distribute). This name was given to girls believed to possess these qualities, often in a religious context. The name Benildis carries the meaning “Benevolent Dispenser” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Benildis usually hope their child will grow to embody benevolent dispenser and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Benildis belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Benevolent Dispenser.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Benildis total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Benildis may have been popularized during the Middle Ages, a time when Christianity heavily influenced European culture. Names were often given based on religious virtues and qualities, making Benildis an appropriate choice for a girl thought to be kind and generous.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, generosity and kindness are widely considered virtues that reflect one's spiritual growth and closeness to God. As the name Benildis suggests, a person with this name is encouraged to distribute kindness and generosity, and to be guided by the Christian virtues of love, compassion, and selflessness.
